name: Push-up
common_faults: partial ROM (not reaching chest to floor)

substitutions.note: loaded barbell version; much higher load ceiling
loaded dumbbell version with full ROM

contraindications: wrist injury aggravated by extended wrist position (use fist push-ups as alternative)
resistance_profile: hardest at the bottom; constant tension with serratus and rotator cuff stabilization throughout

provenance.notes: Excellent bodyweight option. Load ceiling limited without added weight. Serratus anterior activation higher than barbell bench press (scapular protraction at top).
